_comment: Phase AUTH — static admin roster. Reconciled into the `user` table on every app startup by services/admin_sync.sync_admins(). Edit + restart to rotate.
_format: Plaintext passwords are accepted here (the deployer's trust boundary). The startup sync hashes them via bcrypt before persistence. To rotate a password: change the value, restart. To add an admin: append an entry, restart. To revoke: remove the entry; the next boot deactivates the row + deletes their open sessions.
